Quantum Resource Manager and Compiler Infrastructure (QRM&CI) 0.1.0
API Reference

Use this page as an index into the generated Doxygen pages for QRM&CI's public interfaces. For how these pieces fit together, see Build custom QRM&CI workflow; this page is for the exact types and signatures.

Configuration and logging

  • Config, RabbitMqConnectionConfig, SelectorConfig, CompilerConfig, and SubmitterConfig - the runtime configuration model
  • loadConfig - the code-backed defaults < file < environment loading path
  • makeLogger - the console-plus-file logger setup every shipped entrypoint uses

Messaging

  • CommunicationHandler - the templated RabbitMQ send()/receive() helpers. Explicitly non-copyable and non-movable: construct one in place rather than relocating it, and only mqss::QuantumTask, mqss::QuantumResult, and mqss::Backend have a messageLabel() overload – a new message type needs one before send()/receive() for it will compile
  • DefaultReceiveTimeout - the default poll timeout for receive()
  • WaitForever - the timeout value that polls until a message arrives or shutdown is requested
  • receiveNext and drainQueue - the one-message and drain-the-queue loops a daemon turn is built from; both take the caller's termination flag explicitly and stop consuming once it is set
  • sendFailure and sendResult - replying to a task's result_destination

Backends

  • BackendWrapper - one backend's capabilities and status
  • BackendRegistry - backend liveness tracking and deterministic iteration
  • PublicationThrottle - the unrelated concern of pacing a device-owning process's own status refresh/publication, independently of registry liveness
  • BackendSelectionPolicy - the backend tie-break policies

Daemon scaffolding

  • initializeDaemon - signal handlers, configuration, and the process-wide default logger, in one call
  • openConfiguredDevice - open the QDMI device the configuration names
  • registerOwnDevice and refreshOwnDeviceStatus - seed and refresh a device-owning process's own registry entry
  • selectCompileAndSchedule and compileAndSchedule - the intake stage, with and without backend selection
  • TaskScheduler - the scheduler type every submitting daemon runs its tasks through
  • terminationRequested and installTerminationHandlers - the shared clean-shutdown contract

Pipeline operations

  • chooseBackend - the selection rule, without mutating the task
  • compileQuantumTask - the task compilation step
  • submitQuantumTask - submit work without blocking for the result
  • collectQuantumResult - collect the result of a previously submitted job
  • executeQuantumTask - the submit-and-collect path in one call
  • Each of the three above has an interruptible overload taking a const std::atomic<bool>& termination flag, for a daemon work loop that must shut down promptly; the flag-less overloads delegate to it with a flag that is never set and remain unsuitable for daemons. collectQuantumResult waits in short slices rather than one blocking call so the flag is checked between slices even while a job is still running.
  • buildQuantumResult - turn a job-result histogram into the result message. Requires exact cardinality: the histogram must have one entry per the task's circuit files, every entry must carry counts, and every count must fit in the wire format's int32_t – a missing entry, a cardinality mismatch, or an out-of-range count is a DeviceError naming the circuit index (or the offending bitstring and value) rather than a silently trimmed result
  • cancelQuantumTask - the standard cancellation-result shape
  • Every value/error-returning function above is [[nodiscard]]: a caller that means to ignore a result must say so explicitly (e.g. std::ignore =) rather than discard it by accident

Errors

  • Error - the shared failure type for public QRM&CI operations
  • Error::Kind - the categories of failure a QRM&CI operation can report, including ShutdownRequested - returned by an interruptible pipeline operation abandoned because shutdown was requested, not a fault of the task or the device
  • toString - a stable name for an error kind in logs

Scope

Two headers are deliberately absent. ConstantsMapping.h holds the library's own translations between the submitter, mqss protocol, and mqss-ci enumerations. CircuitFormatPolicy.h holds the task/compiler/backend circuit-format admission policy BackendWrapper::canRun() and compileQuantumTask() are built from. Treat both as implementation detail; they may change without notice.

If you are changing these interfaces rather than calling them, see Development Guide.
